title: Transcriptome analysis of JMML patients compare to healthy prenatal and postnatal samples.
description: JMML (Juvenile myelomonocytic leukaemia) is a leukaemia that only develops in young children and is thought to have a prenatal initiation. To study the relationship between JMML and normal ontogeny we studied the transcriptome of HPC (hematopoietic progenitor cells) sorted from sporadic JMML patients, healthy prenatal samples and from healthy age matched donors. Bulk transcriptome of sorted HPC reveals that some JMML samples cluster with prenatal samples whereas other from a distinct cluster apart from any healthy samples. Overall design: Bulk RNAseq data on sorted HPC.
